values.title: Why Global Enterprises Choose Vietlabel
values.subtitle: We don't merely manufacture packaging; we partner with you to engineer solutions that protect and celebrate your brand identity.
values.tab1_desc: Our in-house R&D and structural design team supports you from concept, 3D structural mockups, and certified material sourcing to high-speed batch manufacturing.
values.tab2_desc: Quality management certified under ISO 9001:2015, FSC Chain-of-Custody for sustainable forestry, and HACCP compliance for food-contact packaging safety.
values.tab3_desc: Full-spectrum manufacturing from rigid gift boxes, folding cartons, retail paper bags, bread bags, corrugated shipping boxes to security scratch cards and POSM retail displays.
values.tab4_desc: Heidelberg 6-color offset presses (Germany), Bobst high-precision automatic die-cutters (Switzerland), and computer-controlled foil stamping and spot UV coating lines.
values.tab5_desc: Over 200 print technologists, master craftsmen, and dedicated packaging consultants, maintaining a 99.8% on-time delivery record nationwide and export.

clients.title: Strategic Clients & Partners
clients.subtitle: Trusted by multinational corporations and market-leading retail brands across Southeast Asia and global markets

solutions.title: Our 3-Step Comprehensive Solution
solutions.subtitle: A transparent, structured workflow engineered to save operational time and optimize your procurement budget
solutions.step1_desc: Direct access to FSC-certified paperboard supplies, accommodating orders from pilot validation batches to multi-million production runs with agile lead times.
solutions.step2_desc: Expert structural engineering to maximize sheet imposition efficiency, minimize trim waste, and engineer flat-packing geometries that cut logistics costs.
solutions.step3_desc: Customizable surface embellishments: holographic cold/hot foil stamping, tactile sand varnishing, soft-touch matte lamination, and laser-precise window patching.
